save_torchscript_module: save a TorchScript module to a file or BytesIO buffer with optional extra files
load_torchscript_module: load a previously saved TorchScript module from a file or buffer with map location support
validate_map_location: validate and normalize map_location to torch.device or None with CUDA device validation
load_jit_module_from_flatbuffer: load a TorchScript module from a flatbuffer format file or bytes buffer
save_jit_module_to_flatbuffer: save a TorchScript module to flatbuffer format for cross-language interoperability
get_flatbuffer_module_info: read metadata from a flatbuffer TorchScript module file including bytecode version and operator info
